children.game_version: Simplified box step as a follow-the-leader game with hip sway imitation

seniors.counts: Simplified counts focusing on slow steps
seniors.seated_version: Basic slow-quick-quick steps adapted to seated foot taps and hip sways
seniors.standing_version: Reduced tempo with smaller steps and supported balance
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo, limited hip sway range

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Free arm use with expressive gestures; no fixed arm positions
movement_profile.difficulty: Beginner to advanced depending on figures
movement_profile.footwork: American style: slow-quick-quick box step on beats 1, 3, 4; International style: quick-quick-slow on beats 2, 3, 4
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in closed ballroom hold; social and competition floor space
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Pronounced hip sway over the standing leg; compact torso movement without rise and fall
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Beginners learn basic steps; advanced dancers perform complex turns and figures; no jumps described
movement_profile.partnering: Lead and follow roles with flirtatious interaction; man responds to woman's movements
movement_profile.posture: Upright ballroom posture with relaxed upper body

signature_moves.description: Basic American style step forming a box shape with slow-quick-quick timing
signature_moves.name: Box Step

signature_moves.description: Hip sway over standing leg characteristic of rhumba
signature_moves.name: Cuban Motion

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slow and sensual; International style slower (~120 bpm), American style faster
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid rise and fall movements; maintain compact steps; no jumps or acrobatics

music_profile.musical_form: Arranged son-pregón adapted for ballroom music

reference_recordings.artist: Don Azpiazú and his Havana Casino Orchestra
reference_recordings.title: El manisero (The Peanut Vendor)

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Adapted Afro-Cuban son cubano rhythms with big band swing
music_profile.sound_description: A blend of Afro-Cuban son rhythms with American big band swing, featuring melodic trumpet solos, smooth vocals, and a steady 4/4 beat that supports sensual hip movements.
music_profile.vocal_style: Smooth vocals with occasional trumpet solos

basic_steps: American style box step: slow step forward on beat 1, quick step to side on beat 3, quick step to close on beat 4
International style basic: quick step on beat 2, quick step on beat 3, slow step on beat 4
Maintain pronounced hip sway over standing leg
Keep steps compact without rise and fall
teaching.formation: Couples dance in closed ballroom hold; social and competition settings
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic box or quick-quick-slow steps; intermediate and advanced levels add complex figures and turns
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time with slow-quick-quick (American) or quick-quick-slow (International) step patterns
